Name: That Orange Guy
Overview:
Guide That Orange Guy through 50 levels shooting and igniting everything in your path.

Spot a scary monster? No problem! Just shoot it in the face! Fearsome robot? Light it on fire!

Features:
- 50 levels spanning 5 worlds!
- Over 30 enemies!
- Comrades to rescue!
- Boss fights!
- 3 stars to earn on each level!
